relations.note: Some traditions name Mawu alone as Legba’s mother.
The paired creator is also presented as Legba’s parent.

relations.myth: Distribution of divine realms and languages
relations.note: Legba inspects the divine children’s kingdoms and reports to Mawu.

relations.myth: Distribution of divine realms and languages
relations.note: Mawu gives Legba knowledge of all divine languages.
Mawu judges Legba successful at playing instruments while dancing.
Mawu rewards Legba with Konikoni and precedence among the gods.
Mawu gives Konikoni to Legba as his wife.
Pantheon genealogies commonly list the earth deity among Legba’s siblings.

relations.myth: Distribution of divine realms and languages

relations.note: Djo receives humanity’s language while Legba retains knowledge of every language.
